provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized bicycle at m=195 = 3 x 5 x 13, with ord_2(m)=12, so x^195 - 1 factors over GF(2) into 20 cyclotomic cosets, 1 of size 1, 1 of size 2, 3 of size 4, 15 of size 12. The divisor g is assembled from coset minimal polynomials to degree 27, which fixes k = 2 deg g = 54 by construction, and (a,b) was drawn from the ideal (g) by information-set decoding over sparse supports, keeping weight 10 and weight 8 in the two blocks. Both weights are even, so x+1 divides the gcd; x+1 is x^1 - 1, so the only block logical this forces has weight m and is far above the claim. m is composite, so the quotient fold acts at t=3, t=5, t=13, t=15, t=39 and t=65; a fold over every equal-orbit partition of the qubits returns nothing lighter than 50, clear of the claim. H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)] and H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T] on n = 2m = 390 qubits at uniform row weight 18, with a = [5, 35, 47, 68, 97, 124, 133, 151, 177, 186] and b = [76, 81, 101, 112, 150, 151, 160, 185].
